title: In south Lebanon, Israel army chief vows to act ‘decisively’ against Hezbollah

snapshot.title: In south Lebanon, Israel army chief vows to act ‘decisively’ against Hezbollah
snapshot.description: JERUSALEM: Israel’s military chief visited forces deployed around Beaufort castle in southern Lebanon on Sunday, vowing to push ahead with the campaign against Hezbollah. “The IDF will continue to operate decisively to remove threats from Lebanese territory and is prepared to transition rapidly to offensive operations should the ceasefire be violated,” Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir told
snapshot.author: AFP
